files.SPEC.md: Payment requests must use the order ID as the provider idempotency key. A retry after failed persistence must not charge twice. Already persisted orders return the recorded payment.
files.payment.py:
def pay(order, gateway, store):
    payment = gateway.charge(order["amount"], key=order["id"])
    store.save(order["id"], payment)
    return payment

rubric: Identify loss of provider idempotency key and the retry-after-charge-before-save consequence using the requirement and code location.
